topic: The couple who cut rent to £800 a month — then the boat started sinking

sections.voiceover: They cut their rent from two thousand to eight hundred pounds, moving onto a narrowboat. Then came ten thousand pounds to stop it sinking.
sections.visual_cue: Slow push-in on a narrowboat moored at dawn on a canal. Cool water tones, soft morning mist.
sections.sfx_cue: Low ambient canal bed: gentle water lap, distant mooring rope creak.
b_roll: Narrowboat bow at dawn on the water
Reflection of the boat in still canal water
Wide canal scene with houses in the far background
sections.pacing_notes: First word lands at 0:02. Let the ten-thousand-pound number hang one beat before moving on.
sources: The Independent (17 Jul 2026): Bolton couple cut living costs £2,000 -> £800/month; face £10,000 repair to stop boat sinking

sections.voiceover: In June, Daniel and Charlotte left their jobs and moved onto a three-bed narrowboat. Costs dropped from two thousand to eight hundred a month. Twelve hundred saved, every month.
sections.visual_cue: Hands opening a canal gate, then interior tour shots: compact kitchen, bed, wood-panel walls.
sections.sfx_cue: Ambient shifts to warm interior hum; soft footsteps on wood.
b_roll: Lock gate opening on a narrowboat
Cozy bed built into the hull
sections.transition_out: Hard cut to black, one second silence
sections.pacing_notes: Say the two numbers slowly and clearly. Let twelve hundred land as a clean beat.
sources: The Independent (17 Jul 2026): couple quit day jobs, save £1,200/month on rent, bills and food

sections.voiceover: The space is tight: three hundred square feet, a two-fifty-litre water tank, a toilet emptied by hand. And every fourteen days, the boat must move.
sections.visual_cue: Claustrophobic interior shots, water filler point, then a boat cruising the canal. Slow push toward the horizon.
sections.sfx_cue: Tightening ambience. Water filler gurgle, then engine note rising as the boat gets underway.
b_roll: Filling the water tank from the canal side
Close-up of the Elsan toilet access point
Narrowboat moving along the cut at dusk
sections.pacing_notes: List the three constraints quickly, then slow right down for the fourteen-day rule.
sources: The Independent (17 Jul 2026): 250L water tank, must move every 14 days
The Boat Floats: ~300 sq ft on a 57ft boat; toilet emptying means carrying waste
Canal & River Trust: 14-day 'genuine progression' rule for continuous cruisers

sections.voiceover: Then the boat began to sink. The fix: a completely new base, for ten thousand pounds. Suddenly, eight hundred a month looked small.
sections.visual_cue: Darkening mood: hull close-ups, water lapping at the gunwales, rain on the roof. Single lantern glow.
sections.sfx_cue: Ambience drops to near-silence. Slow creak of the hull, drip of water.
b_roll: Boat in rain, dark canal water
Hands on a wet, worn metal hull
sections.pacing_notes: Pause after 'began to sink'. Deliver 'ten thousand pounds' as the reveal beat.
sources: The Independent (17 Jul 2026): £10,000 repair bill for a completely new base to prevent the boat sinking

sections.voiceover: There's a joke among boaters: Boat stands for Bring Out Another Thousand. Follow Narrowboat Life, for the honest side of the water.
sections.visual_cue: Return to the dawn mooring shot from the hook, identical framing, then fade to black.
sections.sfx_cue: Return of the opening canal ambience. Swell gently, then fade to silence.
b_roll: Boat moored at dawn, same framing as the hook
sections.transition_out: Fade to black. End screen elements appear.
sections.pacing_notes: Pause before the punchline. Understated CTA, one sentence only.
